name: GitHub Copilot
shortDescription: GitHub's AI coding agent for writing code and opening pull requests.
longDescription: GitHub's Copilot page calls it your AI coding agent, says it writes code with AI, and says agents can be directed from issue to merge. That page does not list a dollar price.
pricingNotes: GitHub's page calls Copilot an AI coding agent that writes code and directs agents from issue to merge. No dollar price was in the text we fetched.
bestFor: Writing and reviewing code inside GitHub
notIdealFor: Someone who needs a confirmed monthly price
strength: GitHub calls Copilot an AI coding agent that writes code and can take work from an issue toward a merge.
weakness: The fetched page did not include a dollar price.
smokeTestNotes: Official page checked on 2026-10-19. No account, payment, or hands-on run.
